alcaraz_matches_2024.question: How many matches did Carlos Alcaraz play in 2024?
alcaraz_matches_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_played FROM matches JOIN players ON (matches.player1_id = players.player_id OR matches.player2_id = players.player_id) WHERE players.first_name ILIKE 'Carlos' AND players.last_name ILIKE 'Alcaraz' AND matches.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND matches.match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

sinner_wins_2024.question: How many matches did Jannik Sinner win in 2024?
sinner_wins_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_won FROM matches JOIN players ON matches.winner_id = players.player_id WHERE players.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND players.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' AND match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND match_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

italian_players.question: How many players in the database are from Italy?
italian_players.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS italian_players_count FROM players WHERE nationality ILIKE 'ITA' LIMIT 1000

djokovic_clay_wins.question: How many matches did Novak Djokovic win on clay between 2023 and 2025?
djokovic_clay_wins.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS matches_won_on_clay FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id WHERE p.first_name ILIKE 'Novak' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Djokovic' AND t.surface = 'clay' AND m.match_date >= '2023-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000

us_open_five_setters_2024.question: How many five-set matches were played at the 2024 US Open?
us_open_five_setters_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_set_match_count FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN sets AS s ON m.match_id = s.match_id WHERE t.name ILIKE '%us open%' AND t.year = 2024 GROUP BY m.match_id HAVING COUNT(s.set_id) = 5 LIMIT 1000

alcaraz_sinner_h2h.question: What's the head-to-head record between Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner?
alcaraz_sinner_h2h.sql: WITH players_ids AS (SELECT player_id, first_name, last_name FROM players WHERE (first_name ILIKE 'Carlos' AND last_name ILIKE 'Alcaraz') OR (first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND last_name ILIKE 'Sinner')), matches_between AS (SELECT winner_id, CASE WHEN player1_id = p1.player_id THEN player2_id ELSE player1_id END AS opponent_id FROM matches JOIN players_ids AS p1 ON (matches.player1_id = p1.player_id OR matches.player2_id = p1.player_id) JOIN players_ids AS p2 ON (matches.player1_id = p2.player_id OR matches.player2_id = p2.player_id) WHERE p1.player_id <> p2.player_id) SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS player_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM matches_between AS m JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id LIMIT 10

top5_wins_2024.question: Who are the top 5 players by number of match wins in 2024?
top5_wins_2024.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(m.match_id) AS wins FROM players AS p JOIN matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id WHERE m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY wins DESC LIMIT 5

most_clay_wins_2025.question: Which player won the most matches on clay in 2025?
most_clay_wins_2025.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(*) AS wins_on_clay_2025 FROM matches AS m JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id JOIN players AS p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id WHERE t.surface = 'clay' AND m.match_date >= '2025-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY wins_on_clay_2025 DESC LIMIT 1

sinner_ranking_2024.question: Show Jannik Sinner's ranking trend over 2024.
sinner_ranking_2024.sql: SELECT ranking_date, rank, points FROM rankings_history JOIN players ON rankings_history.player_id = players.player_id WHERE players.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND players.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' AND ranking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND ranking_date < '2025-01-01' ORDER BY ranking_date LIMIT 100

sinner_weeks_at_no1_2024.question: In how many weekly rankings during 2024 was Jannik Sinner ranked number 1?
sinner_weeks_at_no1_2024.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS weeks_at_number_1 FROM rankings_history AS rh JOIN players AS p ON rh.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.first_name ILIKE 'Jannik' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Sinner' AND rh.rank = 1 AND rh.ranking_date >= '2024-01-01' AND rh.ranking_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1000

three_titles_2025.question: Which players won at least 3 tournaments in 2025?
three_titles_2025.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.tournament_id) AS tournaments_won FROM players AS p JOIN matches AS m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id JOIN tournaments AS t ON m.tournament_id = t.tournament_id WHERE t.year = 2025 AND m.round = 'F' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.tournament_id) >= 3 LIMIT 100

medvedev_losses_followup.question: Now just the ones he lost.
medvedev_losses_followup.sql: SELECT m.match_id, m.tournament_id, m.player1_id, m.player2_id, m.winner_id, m.match_date, m.round FROM matches AS m JOIN players AS p ON (m.player1_id = p.player_id OR m.player2_id = p.player_id) WHERE p.first_name ILIKE 'Daniil' AND p.last_name ILIKE 'Medvedev' AND m.match_date >= '2024-01-01' AND m.match_date < '2025-01-01' AND m.winner_id <> p.player_id LIMIT 100

injuries_naming_trap.question: Which players have had an injury lasting more than 30 days?
injuries_naming_trap.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, i.injury_type, i.start_date, i.end_date FROM injuries AS i JOIN players AS p ON i.player_ref = p.player_id WHERE i.end_date IS NOT NULL AND (i.end_date - i.start_date) > 30 LIMIT 100
